column4: a LOWCONF_NOPRE row (no preimage) is resolved by hashing the postimage against every blob of the owner's own history first (git log -- <owner>, rev-parse <commit>:<owner>): here the postimage IS the 2026-10-21 owner blob, the common base of all retained variants, so the owner evolved past it and there is nothing to apply

column4: a retained variant whose blob equals a later commit on the owner's history is SUPERSEDED, not DIVERGENT: compare retained blobs with history blobs before running 3-way merges

column4: compare many versions of one jdk.internal class in one JVM: the live class from the patched java.base plus renamed copies (package jbcoll, class MaskCompactor_<label>) compiled outside java.base; a renamed copy of live is the control (0 mismatches), and a one-token mutant shows the comparison is live.
